title: Squints
description: A new design tool built specifically for the live web, enabling designers to create interactive experiences directly in the browser. This represents an important shift toward real-time, code-aware design workflows that bridge the gap between design and development.

title: loading.dev
description: A lightweight React library offering a curated collection of beautiful, customizable loading indicators for modern web applications. Essential for developers and designers looking to add polished micro-interactions without bloating their bundles.

title: InfraGrid3D
description: A browser-based civil engineering design platform enabling LOD 400+ (detailed) infrastructure design directly in the web. This democratizes specialized design tools and showcases how web technology is expanding into traditionally complex professional domains.

title: Decktly
description: Transforms HTML presentation editing to feel as intuitive as PowerPoint, lowering the barrier for technical presentations. A smart solution that bridges the gap between designers who want control and presenters who want simplicity.

title: Token Forecaster
description: Predicts LLM response length before execution, improving the user experience of AI-powered applications by reducing wait-time uncertainty. A practical solution for designing better interactions around generative AI.

title: MakerMap
description: A dynamic, community-driven map that visualizes makers and their projects in real-time. Valuable for designers and PMs seeking inspiration, discovering talent, and understanding emerging trends in the maker ecosystem.

title: IMG_0001
description: An innovative bot that aggregated 5 million unedited YouTube videos into a searchable dataset, offering raw, authentic content for research and inspiration. Demonstrates creative approaches to mining large-scale data for design insights and trends.

title: GoodSocials
description: An AI-powered social media manager for LinkedIn that prioritizes authentic, genuine content over viral tactics. Reflects a growing shift toward quality engagement and brand authenticity in social strategy design.
